description: Validate a draft Lua script against the local Nightbreak Forge Lua validator. Use this before finalizing generated Lua files to catch unknown helpers, invalid fields, or malformed file structure. **IMPORTANT: pass `script_type` matching the file you are generating.** Use `"lua-power"` (default) for EliteMobs custom-boss Lua powers (files in `powers/`), `"fmm-script"` for FreeMinecraftModels prop scripts (files in `scripts/`), `"npc-script"` for EliteMobs NPC scripts (files in `npc_scripts/`), `"mind-behavior"` for Mind programs and modules (files in `behaviors/`), `"fmm-pet-behavior"` (FreeMinecraftModels pet behavior modules in `pet_behaviors/`, id `fmm:pet/<file name>`; loaded from FMM 2.13.0), or `"em-enchantment-script"` / `"fmm-enchantment-script"` for EliteMobs or FreeMinecraftModels enchantment scripts (files in `enchantments/`). They have different valid hook names and context namespaces — passing the wrong type produces false-positive errors (e.g. `on_right_click` is valid for `fmm-script`, `on_npc_interact` for `npc-script`, but both are rejected for `lua-power`).

content.description: Full Lua script file content to validate.

path.description: Optional path such as "powers/example.lua" or "scripts/fireball_wand.lua" for reporting context.

script_type.description: Which validator ruleset to apply. `"lua-power"` for EliteMobs boss powers, `"fmm-script"` for FMM prop scripts, `"npc-script"` for EliteMobs NPC scripts, `"mind-behavior"` for behaviors/ programs and modules, `"fmm-pet-behavior"` (FreeMinecraftModels pet behavior modules in `pet_behaviors/`, id `fmm:pet/<file name>`; loaded from FMM 2.13.0). Defaults to `"lua-power"`.

name: validate_lua_power_draft
